text:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER DUTY -> SEV2: spike in cross-region latencies and 502s for eu-west -> apac traffic observed. Auto-opened channel #incidents. oncall: alice (oncall). Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/cross-region-steer

alice (oncall): Ack. I'm on it. Seeing elevated p50/p95 from eu-west2 to apac edge starting ~09:08 UTC. Error rate ~0.8% 502s, latency tail up to 1.2s for affected requests.

ben (sre): Noted a config rollout at 09:12 UTC: geo-steer policy "geo-steer-v2" promoted via CI. Could be related. Pulling policy eval logs now.

cara (network): Network dataplane looks healthy from a BGP perspective, no major path changes. DNS TTLs look normal but some edge caches report stale pins.

dave (prod-eng): Repro steps? Any query samples we can test to validate policy decision?

alice (oncall): Running a few queries vs prod:
```
curl -v -H "Host: api.customer-example.com" "https://api.redwood.example/status?region_hint=apac" -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"
```
Responses from eu-west nodes are returning 200 but routed to apac origin in a few cases (unexpected). Policy eval snippet: returning pin=apac for prefixes that should be eu-west.

ben (sre): grabbing policy eval trace: `policy_eval_id=ry9-2026-03-15-0913`
```
[09:13:12] -> input: client_geo=eu-west2, signal_latency=95ms, last_known_affinity=eu-west
[09:13:12] -> rule matched: latency_based -> weight_apac=0.7 (BUG: weight computed from stale metric)
[09:13:12] -> result: chosen_region=apac, pin=true
```
Looks like the metric feed for latency had a stale window, causing apac weight to spike.

cara (network): Edge cache report: selective region pins are being honored by DNS edge for ~12% of requests due to recent cache seeding. TTL is 300s so it'll persist until flushed or expire.

dave (prod-eng): Proposed mitigation: 1) Pause geo-steer-v2 rollout 2) Rollback to geo-steer-v1 3) Expedite edge DNS cache flush for pinned entries 4) Monitor. Anyone object?

alice (oncall): +1. Initiating pause and rollback. ben, can you handle policy rollback? cara, can you coordinate DNS cache purge with CDN team? heidi, prepare customer comms draft.

ben (sre): Running rollback now: `redwoodctl routing policy promote --policy geo-steer-v1 --env prod`
```
> triggering promotion job: job_id=prom-6134567920
> waiting for propagation
```
Estimated propagation time ~2-3min for control-plane, edge caches still need flush.

cara (network): CDN purge queued: `cdnctl purge --selector "region_pin:apac AND prefix:*.customer-example.com" --priority high` job_id=cdn-9876. Requested immediate flush via CDN support. ETA 90s.

heidi (support): Drafting status update for customers: "We're investigating elevated latencies for some API requests routed cross-region; mitigation in progress. No data loss reported. Tracking: INC-6134567890." Will post to status page after initial rollback completes.

incident-bot: Automatic monitoring rule: cross-region-502-alert suppressed during mitigation to reduce noise.

ben (sre): Rollback control-plane completed: `state: geo-steer-v1 active` at 09:17:05 UTC. Watching metrics.

alice (oncall): Observing immediate drop in misrouted evals in policy traces. Edge 502 rate also trending down.

cara (network): CDN support confirms purge applied at 09:18:40 UTC. Edge caches flushed for targeted prefixes.

ben (sre): Metrics: 09:16 -> 09:20 UTC window: error rate from 0.8% -> 0.12%. Latency p95 from 1.2s -> 320ms. Still monitoring for residuals.

dave (prod-eng): Any customer-facing impacts tracked? Which customers saw errors?

heidi (support): Initial list: ~8 customers with heavy APAC traffic reported spike in 502s (IDs redwood-cust-22, -39, -411). I'm opening follow-up support threads to reach out.

alice (oncall): Handoff: I'm paged out in 20m. Ben will be primary after 09:30 UTC. ben, please take over and keep this channel updated. :handshake:

ben (sre): Took over. Running extended observation for 45m. Added 1h increased sampling for steering metrics and alert thresholds tightened.

incident-bot: Automated runbook step executed: post-mitigation probe suite started (probe-suite-id=ps-6134568001).

cara (network): Noted one anomalous host that still served apac pin after purge; found stale config on edge node -> restarted node at 09:23:11 UTC. Post-restart it obeys control-plane.

ben (sre): Full stability observed by 09:34 UTC. Error rates back to baseline. Leaving elevated monitoring until 10:15 UTC.

heidi (support): Posted initial status update on status.redwood.com at 09:28 UTC. Draft for customers includes root cause summary and mitigation steps.

alice (oncall): Incident declared mitigated at 09:34 UTC. Impact: transient misrouting due to stale latency feed causing bad weight calc in geo-steer-v2 + edge cache persistence. Scope: ~12% of EU->APAC routed requests had incorrect region pin during 09:08-09:18 window. Severity: SEV2.

ben (sre): Follow-ups: 1) RCA doc (owner: ben) 2) Add canary gating to geo-steer deployments to validate metric freshness (owner: dave) 3) Reduce critical cache TTL for region pins from 300->60s (owner: cara) 4) Improve alerting on stale metric windows (owner: eng-ml).

heidi (support): I'll follow up with affected customers and include timeline and mitigation.

alice (oncall): Closing channel in 30m unless new regressions. Great coordinated work, team. :tada:

ben (sre): Closing notes: policy eval snippet saved as evidence: `s3://incidents/6134567890/policy-trace-ry9.log`. RCA doc in progress.

incident-bot: Incident INC-6134567890 marked mitigated by alice (oncall) at 09:34:12 UTC.
